text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I am Duramente.
What I must embody... is true "strength."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Merely winning will never be enough.
What is required is an overwhelming, flawless victory.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Let us begin training immediately.
Unless I push myself harder than anyone else, my path will not open."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
